# ui::ThemeRequest

Header: `winui/ui/themes/ThemeSource.hpp`.

What an application asks for. Every field left at its default means "follow the system."

Pass one as [`ui::WindowOptions::theme`](../tree/window-options.md), or later to [Window::set_theme()](../tree/window.md#set_theme), and the window resolves the [Theme](theme.md) from it, and again whenever the system settings change. [resolve_theme()](namespace-ui.md#resolve_theme) makes a fixed [Theme](theme.md) from one.

Example: 
```cpp
int run_app()
{
    ui::ThemeRequest request;
    request.mode            = ui::ThemeMode::Dark;
    request.accent_override = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFFE81123); // brand red instead of the OS accent

    // The system decides everything the request leaves at its default:
    ui::Window app{{.title = "App", .theme = request}};

    // Later, follow the system's light or dark setting again:
    request.mode = ui::ThemeMode::System;
    app.set_theme(request);
    return ui::run(app);
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `ThemeMode` | `ThemeMode::System` | Light, Dark, HighContrast, or System (the default) to follow the system as it changes. |
| `accent_override` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | A brand accent to use in place of [OsThemeSnapshot::accent](os-theme-snapshot.md). Its lighter and darker shades are derived from it. Ignored by the light-only variants and under high contrast. |
| `variant` | `ThemeVariant` | `ThemeVariant::System` | ThemeVariant::System, the default, follows `mode`, as do Fluent2, Fluent, Metro and Mdl2. Every other variant opts into a fixed, light-only palette true to its era, which ignores `mode` and `accent_override` since the era has no dark mode. The exception is a `mode` of HighContrast, which swaps in the era's contrast colors and keeps the era's shapes. [theme_variant_supports_dark_mode()](namespace-ui.md#theme_variant_supports_dark_mode) tells the two sets apart. |
| `classic_scheme` | `std::optional<ClassicPalette>` |  | A [`ClassicPalette`](classic-palette.md) that replaces the era's default colors when `variant` is Windows9x or Windows3x. "Windows 9x with the Eggplant scheme" is one palette away, since those eras' themes are derived from a [ClassicPalette](classic-palette.md) alone. Ignored by every other variant, Luna and Aero included. |
| `early_scheme` | `std::optional<EarlyPalette>` |  | The palette for `variant` Windows1x: Windows 1.01 or Windows 2.03, each in a color and a monochrome version. The variant defaults to [`EarlyPalette::windows_2x_color()`](early-palette.md#windows_2x_color), and this picks any of the other three. Ignored by every other variant. |
| `animations` | `AnimationPreference` | `AnimationPreference::System` | Whether controls animate ([Theme::animations_enabled](theme.md#animations_enabled)): System (the default) follows [OsThemeSnapshot::animations_enabled](os-theme-snapshot.md), On and Off override it. Applies to every variant. |
